expected_outcome: The assistant verifies the customer, checks availability, updates the appointment, and clearly confirms the new date and time.

turns.content: I need to move my appointment to next Monday morning.
I can help with that. Please confirm the last four digits of the phone number on the account.
Thank you. I found your account and will check Monday morning availability.

Your appointment has been updated and confirmed for next Monday at 10:00 AM.
